quarterly_data.quarter: Micron press release: Micron Advances Memory Innovation With the World's First (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Micron demonstrated a 512GB DDR5 RDIMM on multiple server platforms (Micron calls it the world's first 512GB DDR5 module); it vertically stacks DRAM dies interconnected by TSVs, delivers speeds up to 9,200 MT/s, enables up to 12TB of DDR5 in a single 24-slot dual-socket server, and reduces operating power by more than 60% compared with four 128GB RDIMMs. AMD and Intel are both actively validating the module. Micron expects 512GB RDIMMs to be in volume production sometime in the second half of 2027, aligned to customer needs.
quarterly_data.figure: 512GB DDR5 RDIMM, up to 9,200 MT/s; volume production expected in the second half of 2027
